mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.framework_id, t.group_id, t.parent_id, t.level, t.task_name, t.task_type, t.description, t.start_date, t.deadline, t.status, t.finish_time, t.sort, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, f.framework_name, g.group_name from task_info t inner join task_framework f on f.framework_id = t.framework_id and f.del_flag = '0' inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = t.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' where t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: and t.parent_id = #{parentId} order by t.level asc, t.sort asc, t.task_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into task_info (framework_id, group_id, parent_id, level, task_name, task_type, description, start_date, deadline, status, finish_time, sort, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag) values (#{frameworkId}, #{groupId}, #{parentId}, #{level}, #{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{finishTime}, #{sort}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0')
mapper.update: update task_info set parent_id = #{parentId}, level = #{level}, task_name = #{taskName}, task_type = #{taskType}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, deadline = #{deadline}, status = #{status}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, sort = #{sort}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where task_id = #{taskId} and framework_id = #{frameworkId} and group_id = #{groupId} and del_flag = '0'
update task_info set level = #{level}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from task_info where parent_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from task_submission where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0'
